\chapter{Permits and Papers}

\hlchaptermodality{440}

\begin{chapteropening}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ} (paravānagi)}{ಪರವಾನಗಿ (paravānagi)}]{\kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ} (paravānagi) — a permit; a licence}

\label{lesson:KA-C440-paravanagi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for to exchange money, then the Kannada for a cash machine.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ}} — \emph{paravānagi} — \textquotedblleft{}a permit; a licence\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಕಾರು} \kn{ಓಡಿಸಲು} \kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ} \kn{ಬೇಕು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kāru ōḍisalu paravānagi bēku.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
You need a licence to drive a car.
\end{quote}

\kn{ಚಾಲನಾ} \kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ} is a driving licence; in speech many say \kn{ಲೈಸೆನ್ಸ್}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ}} (\emph{paravānagi}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{parvānagī}, \textquotedblleft{}permission\textquotedblright{}, built on \emph{parvāna}, \textquotedblleft{}a written order, a pass\textquotedblright{}, which reached Kannada through Hindustani.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{paravānagi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{paravānagi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kāru ōḍisalu paravānagi bēku.} — You need a licence to drive a car.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for to exchange money, then the Kannada for a cash machine, then say \emph{paravānagi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A permit; a licence\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು} (navīkarisu)}{ನವೀಕರಿಸು (navīkarisu)}]{\kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು} (navīkarisu) — to renew}

\label{lesson:KA-C440-navikarisu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a cash machine, then the Kannada for a permit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು}}
\textbf{\kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು}} — \emph{navīkarisu} — \textquotedblleft{}to renew\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ನಾನು} \kn{ನನ್ನ} \kn{ಪಾಸ್ಪೋರ್ಟನ್ನು} \kn{ಕಳೆದ} \kn{ತಿಂಗಳು} \kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸಿದೆ}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nānu nanna pāspōrṭannu kaḷeda tiṅgaḷu navīkariside.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I renewed my passport last month.
\end{quote}

Past (I …): \kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸಿದೆ}, \emph{navīkariside}.

What is renewed takes -\kn{ಅನ್ನು}: \kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿಯನ್ನು} \kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು}} (\emph{navīkarisu}) is built from Sanskrit \emph{navīkaraṇa}, \textquotedblleft{}making new, renewing\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), on \emph{nava}, \textquotedblleft{}new\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 6983), with the verb ending -\emph{isu}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{navīkarisu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{navīkarisu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nānu nanna pāspōrṭannu kaḷeda tiṅgaḷu navīkariside.} — I renewed my passport last month.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for a cash machine, then the Kannada for a permit, then say \emph{navīkarisu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To renew\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು} (dṛḍhapaḍisu)}{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು (dṛḍhapaḍisu)}]{\kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು} (dṛḍhapaḍisu) — to confirm}

\label{lesson:KA-C440-drdhapadisu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for a permit, then the Kannada for to renew.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು}}
\textbf{\kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು}} — \emph{dṛḍhapaḍisu} — \textquotedblleft{}to confirm\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಹೋಟೆಲ್} \kn{ಇಮೇಲ್} \kn{ಮೂಲಕ} \kn{ನಮ್ಮ} \kn{ಕೋಣೆಯನ್ನು} \kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸಿತು}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{hōṭel imēl mūlaka namma kōṇeyannu dṛḍhapaḍisitu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The hotel confirmed our room by email.
\end{quote}

Past (I …): \kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸಿದೆ}, \emph{dṛḍhapaḍiside}.

\kn{ದೃಢ} means firm or sure; -\kn{ಪಡಿಸು} makes a verb of it: to make sure.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು}} (\emph{dṛḍhapaḍisu}) is built from Sanskrit \emph{dṛḍha}, \textquotedblleft{}fixed, firm, solid\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), and the Kannada verb-maker -\emph{paḍisu}: to make a thing firm.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dṛḍhapaḍisu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dṛḍhapaḍisu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hōṭel imēl mūlaka namma kōṇeyannu dṛḍhapaḍisitu.} — The hotel confirmed our room by email.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for a permit, then the Kannada for to renew, then say \emph{dṛḍhapaḍisu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To confirm\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ} (rāyabhāra kacēri)}{ರಾಯಭಾರ ಕಚೇರಿ (rāyabhāra kacēri)}]{\kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ} (rāyabhāra kacēri) — an embassy}

\label{lesson:KA-C440-rayabhara-kaceri}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for to renew, then the Kannada for to confirm.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ}}
\textbf{\kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ}} — \emph{rāyabhāra kacēri} — \textquotedblleft{}an embassy\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ನಾನು} \kn{ವೀಸಾಗಾಗಿ} \kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿಗೆ} \kn{ಹೋದೆ}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nānu vīsāgāgi rāyabhāra kacērige hōde.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I went to the embassy for a visa.
\end{quote}

\kn{ರಾಯಭಾರಿ} is an ambassador; \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ} is an office.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ}} (\emph{rāyabhāra kacēri}) joins \kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ}, \textquotedblleft{}an envoy's charge\textquotedblright{}, and \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ}, \textquotedblleft{}an office\textquotedblright{}. \kn{ರಾಯ} comes from Sanskrit \emph{rājan}, \textquotedblleft{}a king\textquotedblright{}, through Prakrit \emph{rāya} (CDIAL 10679); how \emph{bhāra}, \textquotedblleft{}a burden\textquotedblright{}, came to mean an envoy's office is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{rāyabhāra kacēri}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{rāyabhāra kacēri}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nānu vīsāgāgi rāyabhāra kacērige hōde.} — I went to the embassy for a visa.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for to renew, then the Kannada for to confirm, then say \emph{rāyabhāra kacēri} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An embassy\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ} (antararāṣṭrīya)}{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ (antararāṣṭrīya)}]{\kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ} (antararāṣṭrīya) — international}

\label{lesson:KA-C440-antararastriya}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Kannada for to confirm, then the Kannada for an embassy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ}}
\textbf{\kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ}} — \emph{antararāṣṭrīya} — \textquotedblleft{}international\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\kn{ಈ} \kn{ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ} \kn{ಒಂದು} \kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ} \kn{ವಿಮಾನ} \kn{ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ} \kn{ಇದೆ}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ī nagaradalli ondu antararāṣṭrīya vimāna nildāṇa ide.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This city has an international airport.
\end{quote}

\kn{ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ} is a nation and \kn{ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ} national; \kn{ಅಂತರ}- adds between.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ}} (\emph{antararāṣṭrīya}) is a modern compound built from Sanskrit words: \emph{antara}, \textquotedblleft{}inside, between\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 357), and \emph{rāṣṭra}, \textquotedblleft{}a kingdom, a country\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 10721), with the adjective ending -\emph{īya}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for getting around.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{antararāṣṭrīya}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{antararāṣṭrīya}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ī nagaradalli ondu antararāṣṭrīya vimāna nildāṇa ide.} — This city has an international airport.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Kannada for to confirm, then the Kannada for an embassy, then say \emph{antararāṣṭrīya} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}International\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Getting around}

\label{lesson:KA-R440-review-433-440}



\begin{quote}
Say the Kannada for a passenger and a railway platform.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a passenger, a railway platform, a railway coach, a rail track, to reach
  \item a delay, to arrive, to depart, a halt, to enquire
  \item a berth, a formal seat, to slip away, to peep, a fare
  \item a porter, a trolley, to load, hand luggage, to fill up
  \item an airport, a terminal, a boarding pass, to scan, a pilot
  \item to weigh, a limit, to exceed, air travel, a helicopter
  \item a visa, customs, a customs duty, to exchange money, a cash machine
  \item a permit, to renew, to confirm, an embassy, international
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A passenger? (\textbf{\kn{ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕ}}, \emph{prayāṇika}.) A railway platform? (\textbf{\kn{ಪ್ಲಾಟ್ಫಾರ್ಮ್}}, \emph{plāṭphārm}.) A railway coach? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೋಗಿ}}, \emph{bōgi}.) A rail track? (\textbf{\kn{ಹಳಿ}}, \emph{haḷi}.) To reach? (\textbf{\kn{ತಲುಪು}}, \emph{talupu}.) A delay? (\textbf{\kn{ವಿಳಂಬ}}, \emph{viḷamba}.) To arrive? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಗಮಿಸು}}, \emph{āgamisu}.) To depart? (\textbf{\kn{ನಿರ್ಗಮಿಸು}}, \emph{nirgamisu}.) A halt? (\textbf{\kn{ನಿಲುಗಡೆ}}, \emph{nilugaḍe}.) To enquire? (\textbf{\kn{ವಿಚಾರಿಸು}}, \emph{vicārisu}.) A berth? (\textbf{\kn{ಬರ್ತ್}}, \emph{bart}.) A formal seat? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಸನ}}, \emph{āsana}.) To slip away? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೈತಪ್ಪು}}, \emph{kaitappu}.) To peep? (\textbf{\kn{ಇಣುಕು}}, \emph{iṇuku}.) A fare? (\textbf{\kn{ದರ}}, \emph{dara}.) A porter? (\textbf{\kn{ಹಮಾಲಿ}}, \emph{hamāli}.) A trolley? (\textbf{\kn{ಟ್ರಾಲಿ}}, \emph{ṭrāli}.) To load? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೇರು}}, \emph{hēru}.) Hand luggage? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೈಸಾಮಾನು}}, \emph{kaisāmānu}.) To fill up? (\textbf{\kn{ಭರ್ತಿಯಾಗು}}, \emph{bhartiyāgu}.) An airport? (\textbf{\kn{ಏರ್ಪೋರ್ಟ್}}, \emph{ērpōrṭ}.) A terminal? (\textbf{\kn{ಟರ್ಮಿನಲ್}}, \emph{ṭarminal}.) A boarding pass? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೋರ್ಡಿಂಗ್} \kn{ಪಾಸ್}}, \emph{bōrḍiṅg pās}.) To scan? (\textbf{\kn{ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನ್} \kn{ಮಾಡು}}, \emph{skyān māḍu}.) A pilot? (\textbf{\kn{ಪೈಲಟ್}}, \emph{pailaṭ}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\kn{ತೂಗು}}, \emph{tūgu}.) A limit? (\textbf{\kn{ಮಿತಿ}}, \emph{miti}.) To exceed? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೀರು}}, \emph{mīru}.) Air travel? (\textbf{\kn{ವಿಮಾನಯಾನ}}, \emph{vimānayāna}.) A helicopter? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೆಲಿಕಾಪ್ಟರ್}}, \emph{helikāpṭar}.) A visa? (\textbf{\kn{ವೀಸಾ}}, \emph{vīsā}.) Customs? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಸ್ಟಮ್ಸ್}}, \emph{kasṭams}.) A customs duty? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುಂಕ}}, \emph{suṅka}.) To exchange money? (\textbf{\kn{ವಿನಿಮಯ} \kn{ಮಾಡು}}, \emph{vinimaya māḍu}.) A cash machine? (\textbf{\kn{ಎಟಿಎಂ}}, \emph{eṭieṃ}.) A permit? (\textbf{\kn{ಪರವಾನಗಿ}}, \emph{paravānagi}.) To renew? (\textbf{\kn{ನವೀಕರಿಸು}}, \emph{navīkarisu}.) To confirm? (\textbf{\kn{ದೃಢಪಡಿಸು}}, \emph{dṛḍhapaḍisu}.) An embassy? (\textbf{\kn{ರಾಯಭಾರ} \kn{ಕಚೇರಿ}}, \emph{rāyabhāra kacēri}.) International? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಂತರರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ}}, \emph{antararāṣṭrīya}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
